title: AUTHORIZATION FOR BULK AND PARKING MODIFICATIONS
previewText: The City Planning Commission may, by authorization, permit modifications to the bulk and accessory off-street parking requirements of the applicable zoning districts when a change of use of a FRESH food store for which a certification has been issued, pursuant to Section 63-30, would create a new non-compliance, increase the degree of non-compliance of buildings on the zoning lot, or result in fewer accessory off-str

blocks.html: The City Planning Commission may, by authorization, permit modifications to the bulk and accessory off-street parking requirements of the applicable zoning districts when a change of use of a FRESH food store for which a certification has been issued, pursuant to Section 63-30, would create a new non-compliance, increase the degree of non-compliance of buildings on the zoning lot, or result in fewer accessory off-street parking spaces than required by the new use pursuant to Section 63-24 (Required Accessory Off-street Parking Spaces in Certain Districts), provided that such use is permitted by the underlying districts.
blocks.plainText: The City Planning Commission may, by authorization, permit modifications to the bulk and accessory off-street parking requirements of the applicable zoning districts when a change of use of a FRESH food store for which a certification has been issued, pursuant to Section 63-30, would create a new non-compliance, increase the degree of non-compliance of buildings on the zoning lot, or result in fewer accessory off-street parking spaces than required by the new use pursuant to Section 63-24 (Required Accessory Off-street Parking Spaces in Certain Districts), provided that such use is permitted by the underlying districts.

blocks.html: In order to grant such authorization, the Commission shall find that:
blocks.plainText: In order to grant such authorization, the Commission shall find that:

blocks.html: (a)        due to the market conditions prevalent at the time of the application, there is no reasonable possibility that the operation of a FRESH food store will bring a reasonable return;
blocks.plainText: (a) due to the market conditions prevalent at the time of the application, there is no reasonable possibility that the operation of a FRESH food store will bring a reasonable return;

blocks.html: (b)        the applicant, the operator or a prior operator of such FRESH food store has not created or contributed to such unfavorable market conditions;
blocks.plainText: (b) the applicant, the operator or a prior operator of such FRESH food store has not created or contributed to such unfavorable market conditions;

blocks.html: (c)        the applicant, the operator or a prior operator of such FRESH food store has undertaken commercially reasonable efforts to secure a new operator, and demonstrates to the Commission that such efforts have been unsuccessful;
blocks.plainText: (c) the applicant, the operator or a prior operator of such FRESH food store has undertaken commercially reasonable efforts to secure a new operator, and demonstrates to the Commission that such efforts have been unsuccessful;

blocks.html: (d)        any proposed non-compliance or increase in the degree of non-compliance will not be incompatible with or adversely affect adjacent uses, including uses within the building; and
blocks.plainText: (d) any proposed non-compliance or increase in the degree of non-compliance will not be incompatible with or adversely affect adjacent uses, including uses within the building; and

blocks.html: (e)        any reduction of required accessory off-street parking shall not create or contribute to serious traffic congestion and will not unduly inhibit surface traffic and pedestrian movement.
blocks.plainText: (e) any reduction of required accessory off-street parking shall not create or contribute to serious traffic congestion and will not unduly inhibit surface traffic and pedestrian movement.

blocks.html: If such authorization is granted, a notice of cancellation, in a form acceptable to the Department of City Planning, of the declaration of restrictions recorded pursuant to Section 63-30, shall be executed and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York against all tax lots comprising the former FRESH food store.
blocks.plainText: If such authorization is granted, a notice of cancellation, in a form acceptable to the Department of City Planning, of the declaration of restrictions recorded pursuant to Section 63-30, shall be executed and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York against all tax lots comprising the former FRESH food store.

blocks.html: In issuing an authorization under this Section, the Commission may impose conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse impacts on the character of the surrounding area.
